data.title: EC's shockwave upsets 'blue camp'
data.description: The Election Commission (EC)'s decision to refer the Senate vote-rigging case, which involves 77 suspects, to the Supreme Court has put 26 serving senators from the so-called "blue camp" -- politicians linked to the ruling Bhumjaithai (BJT) Party -- at the centre of a legal process that could shift the balance of power in the upper house.

data.title: Dems demand review of frigate plan
data.description: The Democrat Party on Saturday demanded the Defence Ministry revise its 17‑billion‑baht frigate procurement plan, citing potential corruption in the bidding process.

data.title: Chinese man linked to B1bn gambling network arrested in Chon Buri
data.description: A Chinese national wanted in his home country in connection with an illegal online gambling and money-laundering operation with nearly 1 billion baht in circulation has been arrested near Pattaya.

data.title: Flash floods hit Phetchabun as Pasak River overflows
data.description: Flash floods inundated communities in Lom Sak district of Phetchabun province after heavy overnight rain caused the Pasak River to overflow its banks, forcing about 300 households to evacuate on Saturday.

data.title: Two defence volunteers killed in Narathiwat attack
data.description: NARATHIWAT - Two territorial defence volunteers were killed and 16 others injured, six of them seriously, when a six-wheel truck carrying them was hit by a roadside bomb and then came under gunfire in Sukhirin district of Narathiwat on Friday afternoon.

data.title: B20.4bn seizure a highlight of illegal business crackdown
data.description: Thai authorities have seized or frozen about 20.4 billion baht in assets linked to a financial network tied to Cambodian businessman Yim Leak and financier Benjamin Mauerberger, according to an update delivered on Friday.

data.title: White lion cub seized from unlicensed hotel in Chiang Mai
data.description: A Chinese woman was arrested on Friday after authorities discovered a white lion cub at an unlicensed hotel illegally operated and catering to Chinese tourists in Muang district in Chiang Mai.

data.title: Over 100 gamblers arrested at two Chiang Mai dens
data.description: CHIANG MAI — More than 100 people were arrested on Friday night when authorities raided two large gambling dens equipped with tight security measures.

data.title: Premier brushes off criticism of EC
data.description: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul yesterday brushed off criticism of the Election Commission (EC) after it ruled on the Senate collusion case, saying the matter had nothing to do with his responsibilities as prime minister.

data.title: Trust remains elusive
data.description: The main opposition People's Party (PP) may be calling on Pheu Thai to abandon the Bhumjaithai (BJT)-led coalition government, but rebuilding trust between the two parties could prove considerably harder than bringing them together against a common political adversary.

data.title: Nong Khai's new rail run makes debut
data.description: The Transport Ministry yesterday test-ran a rail freight service from Laem Chabang to Nong Khai and back under a public-private model aimed at making Thailand a regional logistics hub.

data.title: B20.39bn seized in nominee network crackdown
data.description: About 20.39 billion baht in assets linked to a financial network tied to Cambodian businessman Yim Leak and Benjamin Mauerberger, also known as Ben Smith, have been seized or frozen, government spokesman Dr Ekkapob Pianpises said.

data.title: Panel backs 4 diseases for watch list
data.description: The National Communicable Diseases Committee has approved a draft Public Health Ministry announcement adding four diseases to the list of communicable diseases requiring surveillance.

data.title: Tighter birth checks target fake fathers
data.description: The Public Health Ministry has tightened procedures for certifying births at public and private hospitals as part of a government crackdown on "fake father" schemes used to obtain Thai nationality unlawfully.

data.title: Household target doubled
data.description: The government has doubled its household solar power target to 10,000 megawatts and will buy surplus electricity at 2.20 baht per unit under 20-year agreements, deputy government spokeswoman Lalida Persvivatana said.

data.title: UK scholar says 'even facts can mislead'
data.description: Accurate facts can be just as misleading as outright falsehoods when selectively presented or misinterpreted, says London Business School finance professor Alex Edmans.

data.title: Dental clinic warning issued
data.description: The Department of Health Service Support has urged patients to verify dental clinics and practitioners before seeking treatment, following the arrest of a woman accused of running an unlicensed dental service from her home in Ayutthaya.

data.title: Anutin preps coalition for censure test
data.description: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul said he was in contact with coalition leaders and ministers and was preparing another dinner meeting to strengthen ties ahead of the upcoming censure debate.

data.title: Navy stands by frigate bidding
data.description: The Royal Thai Navy has come under public scrutiny after only one company, South Korea's Hanwha Ocean, was deemed qualified to take on the 17-billion-baht frigate procurement.

data.title: Recipients may get 1,000-baht boost
data.description: The government has indicated that the second phase of the Thais Help Thais Plus co-payment scheme is likely to provide a one-off 1,000-baht allowance, which can be used over two months.

data.title: Thailand at heart of Miss Universe turmoil
data.description: Miss Universe Thailand and five of her Southeast Asian peers could be barred from competing in the Miss Universe 2026 pageant in November because of a bitter legal dispute over national franchise agreements.

data.title: Elderly couple in Buri Ram die hours apart after decades together
data.description: A story of enduring love between an elderly couple in Buri Ram has moved people online after the pair, married for decades, died within hours of each other. The husband, who passed away first, died just 10 minutes after his wife returned home from hospital — with their grandchildren saying he had likely been waiting for her.

data.title: Australian suspect in Pattaya teen's murder denied bail
data.description: The Australian suspect in the killing of a Thai girl was denied bail on Friday after refuting the allegation and other charges at the Pattaya Provincial Court.

data.title: Heirs of land donor press on with temple land challenge
data.description: KHON KAEN – Chommanee Noichan, widely known as “Aunt Da,” and an estate administrator reported to police on Friday to acknowledge charges in connection with a dispute over land donated to a forest temple in Muang district of this northeastern province.

data.title: Bomb, shooting attack on defence volunteer truck in Narathiwat
data.description: NARATHIWAT – An unknown number of assailants detonated a bomb and opened fire on a six-wheel truck carrying territorial defence voluneers in Sukhirin district of this southern border province on Friday afternoon. No injuries or deaths were reported.
